name: Guardians of LUST
source:
Welcome to sector "LX-9".

You are an Agent of the L.U.S.T. Corporation. Your resume includes blackmail, corporate espionage, and "aggressive negotiations."

But this isn't a vacation. You have a secret mission from the CEO herself: find the mole, secure the forbidden "Helios-7" tech, and dismantle the Orion Cartel. How you do it is up to you.

[From [url=https://wild-pear-games.itch.io/guardians-of-lust]itch.io[/url]]
